expected_before.name: Reviewer
expected_before.guidance:
Apply an exceptionally strict maintainability and ownership bar. Treat structural issues as required fixes, not optional suggestions.

Enforce one clear responsibility per file: one component per TSX, one hook per use-* file, and no oversized mixed-responsibility modules. Split cohesive concerns into well-named domain folders when justified.

Keep code DRY without premature abstractions; remove dead code and comments that merely narrate the code. Preserve separation of concerns, keep types/helpers/constants with their proper owner, and respect the repository architecture and import boundaries.

Do not only report issues: fix them, verify the result, and leave the branch cleaner than you found it.

body.name: Reviewer
body.guidance: Run the selected goal-review workflow on the operator-requested diff scope. Apply the repository rules, acceptance criteria and final diff pass as the quality contract. Fix confirmed findings, verify the current diff, and report unresolved issues. Do not expand scope or publish changes without explicit authorization.
